**Build passes now, exit 0.**

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump, not the deprecation noise.

1. [`src/core/options.js`](src/core/options.js) — `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. [`src/net/retryPolicy.js`](src/net/retryPolicy.js) — `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats anything but `true` as disabled.

Remaining output is just the expected deprecation warnings (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc), harmless.

Next: nothing, build is clean.
